text:
maya: Heads up — noticed the dashboard charts freeze when I toggle the region filter on the canary (~10%). Repro on Chrome and Firefox.

orion: repro'd. CPU spikes then main thread blocks for ~600-1200ms on first toggle. Seems correlated with a bundle chunk fetch.

carlos: any Sentry/telemetry IDs?

maya: https://sentry.redwood/issue/ABC-123 (linked in the canary) — stacktrace points to ChartRenderer.render -> formatSeriesWithTelemetry.

anika: throwing in some telemetry: perf marks show long GC after the chunk loads, but the freeze starts before GC. Network shows a 1xx-3xx KB chunk fetch and then a big script parse/compile.

sam: can we check if this is the large viz lib being eagerly parsed? Last deploy bumped a charting widget to a new bundle split.

lia: deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-18T14:23 completed to canary-10%.

deploy-bot: [info] canary rollout set to 10% for release/2026-03-18-visuals.

orion: timeline from DevTools:
```
NavigationStart 0
fetch chunk /static/js/chunk-viz.2c9a.js 230ms
evaluate script chunk-viz.2c9a.js 450ms
main thread busy 600-1200ms
```

carlos: that evaluate time is huge — likely cold JIT + large function bodies. Any chance the runtime routing policy caused a fallback to a larger chunk?

anika: yes — noticed that requests for chunk-viz sometimes go to origin instead of edge CDN with cache-control still 1h. Headers show: x-cache: MISS, x-edge-region: eu-west.

maya: also seeing kv-prefetch misses on the same timeframe: x-kv-prefetch: miss. That lines up with first-time view after route affinity change.

sam: I think two things combined: 1) route reassignment during canary causes user sessions to hit new edge with cold cache for chunk and kv, 2) the chunk contains a heavy transformer for axis layout that triggers long parse/compile.

lia: rk-ux: any UX mitigation we can quickly do? e.g., skeletons or disable heavy animations for toggles?

rk-ux: quick wins: show skeletons + optimistic empty chart frame, and defer mounting heavy ChartRenderer until idle using requestIdleCallback fallback. That would hide the jank but not solve parse cost.

orion: code snippet for lazy mount I tried: 
```
const mountChart = () => {
  if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) {
    requestIdleCallback(() => import('./ChartRenderer').then(m => m.init()));
  } else {
    setTimeout(() => import('./ChartRenderer').then(m => m.init()), 0);
  }
}
```

carlos: also consider splitting axis-layout into its own chunk smaller than full viz bundle. We can change webpack dynamic import boundary.

anika: telemetry added: added metric console.chart.parse_ms and console.chunk.cache_miss to help correlate.

maya: one more oddity — routing policy logs show affinity rebalancer triggered during canary ramp:
```
[rebalancer] session reassign user=uid-888 -> region=eu-west-2 (was us-west-1)
```

sam: OK that explains the origin misses. Rebalancer moved users mid-session while their browser had cached references to chunk urls tied to region-based CDN hostnames.

lia: infra-bot: snapshot of CDN edge config shows new region hostname mapping rolled out yesterday with TTL 300s for host aliases.

infra-bot: [config] cdn.host-alias-ttl=300s, origin-pull-cache=3600s

carlos: eviction TTL too low for alias mapping; if rebalancer switches host alias, client will request from new alias which has cold cache. We can: increase alias TTL or change routing to keep hostnames constant across regions.

orion: short-term mitigation options: 1) pin chunk URLs to a global host (cdn.redwood/static/...), 2) increase alias TTL, 3) make chunk fetch resilient by prefetching chunk on route change in background.

anika: prefetch idea is good — we can leverage the existing kv-prefetch mechanism to also warm chunk URLs. Add header x-warm-chunk when we know session is being reassigned.

maya: what about A/B rollback? Should we rollback canary WIP?

sam: let's pause ramp to 10% (freeze at current), add prefetch + skeleton, and ship axis-layout split tomorrow. If that doesn't help, rollback.

lia: I'll file a rollout hold. deploy-bot: pause canary ramp for release/2026-03-18-visuals.

deploy-bot: [action] canary ramp paused.

carlos: follow-ups:
- split axis-layout into its own dynamic import (owner: eng-runtime)
- add chunk-prefetch on rebalancer event (owner: eng-platform)
- change cdn alias TTL to 1h as temporary (owner: infra)
- UX: add skeleton + idle-mount (owner: eng-platform/rk-ux)

orion: I'll run a small lab test simulating rebalancer switches and measure parse/eval time with and without the split.

anika: I'll keep the telemetry live and add a dashboard tile for console.chart.parse_ms by region + chunk cache hit.

maya: thanks all. saving logs and perf traces to the incident thread. tagging folks: @orion @carlos @rk-ux

rk-ux: :thumbsup: will prepare UX patch.

infra-bot: [note] cdn.alias-ttl set to 3600s in staging for test.

deploy-bot: [info] canary remains at 10% but ramp paused.

carlos: final ask before we close: add a small-sized fallback bundle that covers chart interaction primitives so toggles don't need full viz parse on first use. Could be ~20KB. Thoughts?

orion: good idea — microbundle for interaction layer. I'll prototype after the split.

maya: moving this to follow-up sprint ticket. closing thread for now.

sam: thanks everyone.
